title: Bid Walkthrough Approval Form
use_case: Use the approval form during pre-bid site walkthrough and constraint capture when the bid walkthrough record must identify bid package, site zones, existing systems, access routes, working hours, utilities, and owner-furnished information. Complete the applicable handoff for bid assumptions, RFI list, estimate handoff, risk allowance, addendum tracking, and acknowledgment record.
